name: io.github.numeratica/mcp
title: Numeratica — financial planning calculations
description: Deterministic US financial planning: retirement Monte Carlo, Roth conversion, RMD, tax, IRMAA, SS

environmentVariables.name: NUMERATICA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Numeratica API key (nmr_sk_...). Free self-serve key at https://docs.numeratica.com/get-key

environmentVariables.name: NUMERATICA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.numeratica.com; only needed for a staging or self-hosted deployment.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Numeratica API key>. Required to CALL a tool; initialize, tools/list and ping answer without it, so a client or registry can enumerate the catalogue before signing up.
